source.variant: historical noncanonical Wikidata-derived mirror; DO NOT use original published benchmark comparisons

split.method: exact WSP103 1/32 group holdout by full (subject,predicate), 4096 lowest SHA256-derived-priority query groups

experimental_question: Is the WSP103 masked real-graph fact task immediately saturated by inexpensive retained-only relation-frequency controls? This is a dev diagnostic, not a test of a trained general KG model or direct-weight improvement.

controls.name: relation-conditioned frequent-object learner
controls.method: deterministic Misra-Gries capacity 64 objects for each predicate over all retained rows; second read counts those 64 candidates exactly and ranks descending frequency, ascending QID for ties

controls.name: frequency order negative control
controls.method: reverse-ranked same 64 object candidates, preserving candidate set but not strength order

measures: macro best-answer reciprocal rank over at most 64 candidates
number of 4096 groups with no candidates
wall CPU and source bytes and candidate counts
stop: If heuristic Hits@10 >=0.95, record DEV saturation and do not tune this split.
